about.title: About & History of the Association
about.subtitle: Identity, vision, mission, and history of St. George Believers Association
about.visionDesc: To unite all believers in holiness, love, and spiritual maturity, empowering them for divine ministry and social welfare.
about.missionDesc: To preach the Gospel, support the underprivileged, nurture upright youth, and modernize ministry operations with cutting-edge digital platforms.
about.historyP1: Waldaa Amantoota Qulqulluu Giyoorgisii was founded in 2010 by devoted believers seeking to unify believers across local and distant regions for coordinated prayer, spiritual edification, and mutual charity.
about.historyP2: Today, it has expanded branches across Finfinnee, Adaamaa, Bishooftuu, Amboo, Haramaayaa, and beyond, serving thousands of active members.
about.ms1Desc: Initial foundation established with 50 founding members.
about.ms2Desc: Expansion to Adaamaa and Bishooftuu branch centers.
about.ms3Desc: Launch of nationwide humanitarian and charitable relief programs.
about.ms4Desc: Deployment of the next-generation digital portal and Gospel Radio services.

services.s4Desc: Delivering uplifting gospel songs and sermons through YouTube and continuous Gospel Radio for all members.
